decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app builds directly on the firm's deep knowledge of dental practice workflows and its software engineering, and it is presented as the flagship of a new product line, so the firm can readily interpret early results and refine it.

A continuing education institute is further from core software development but draws on the firm's existing training content and practitioner relationships, which makes it a plausible, low-cost complement that strengthens customer ties.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is closely tied to the firm's established customer support operations and is cheap to maintain, so it is likely to stay as part of its support infrastructure.
